sources.title: Parakeet · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Parakeet models, introduced by NVIDIA NeMo, are models that combine a Fast Conformer encoder with connectionist temporal classification (CTC), recurrent neural network transducer (RNNT) or token and duration transducer (TDT) decoder for automatic speech recognition.

sources.title: nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 · Hugging Face
